# fix(hfp-009): render transcript highlights without v-html

## Task

`ResearchWorkbench.vue` renders each transcript block with `v-html="highlightTranscriptText(block.text)"`. That function wraps evidence matches in `<mark>` and returns an HTML string built from the transcript text. Any markup in a transcript is therefore inserted into the page as raw HTML. Today the text comes only from mock data. Once researchers upload their own files (HFP-011), a transcript containing `<img src=x onerror=...>` runs script in the app. That is an XSS risk.

Split each block into text parts and highlighted parts, and render them as text nodes (`<template v-for>` with `<mark>` for matches). Vue then escapes everything.

## Parent Story

ResearchWorkbench follow-ups (found 2026-10-26). Must land before transcript upload (HFP-011).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No `v-html` remains in `ResearchWorkbench.vue`; highlighting produces the same visible result with `<mark class="highlight-active">`.
- [ ] Highlighting stays case-insensitive and handles several evidence strings, overlapping or repeated matches, and regex special characters, as today.
- [ ] Text selection for "Create Card" (`handleSelection`) still works across highlighted and plain parts.
- [ ] Spec: a segment whose text contains `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` renders as literal text and adds no `<img>` element.
- [ ] Spec: the evidence of the active card is wrapped in `<mark>`; text without evidence is not.
- [ ] Optional: move the splitting into a small pure function (e.g. `splitHighlights(text, needles)`) with its own spec.
